data.name: Biochar Solutions
data.description: Biochar Solutions Inc. is a small biochar company based in Colorado and founded in 2011. It made pyrolysis equipment and engineered biochar, and its subsidiary Biochar Reclamation Labs worked on restoring damaged mining and farm soils. It was merged into The Biochar Company (the Soil Reef brand), and PitchBook lists it as acquired/merged with about 2 employees.
